page.overview:
Who is Dragonlord?

The Dragonlord is the main antagonist and final boss of the original Dragon Quest, a franchise owned by Square Enix. Before the game starts, he steals the Sphere of Light to bring forth monsters and unleash his forces of darkness upon the continent of Alefgard, only to be stopped by the Hero. He was introduced to the Final Fantasy series in a collaboration by Final Fantasy Brave Exvius.

He also appears as a boss in the collaboration's challenge event, aptly called Dragonlord's Challenge.

The Dragonlord has two distinctive and iconic appearances: the first is as a blue-skinned robed sorcerer that looks relatively human, and his true form, a massive, purple-scaled dragon far larger than any other.

The Dragonlord is an archetypal power-hungry despot: vain, arrogant, and willing to stop at nothing to get what he desires. He is opportunistic and clever, and always operates with a plan. While his tactics in Dragon Quest are often framed as simply being destructive, the Dragonlord has a cold, calculating streak, kidnapping Princess Gwaelin to demoralize her father, King Lorik XVI, stealing the Sphere of Light to deter would-be heroes, and destroying the entire town of Damdara to neuter the Kingdom of Alefgard's ability to fight back against his army.
